about: Every surface Reader V3 trained on, resolved to public segment ids, with the units its author scored before release; built by `python -m kit.readerseen build` from the pinned files in docs/evidence/readerseen/ (metadata only: no label, CT, preview, mesh or map). Never edit by hand; `python -m kit.readerseen verify` rebuilds it and fails on drift.

reader_v3_config.label: Sourced fact for the file; Community report that it is what was trained

reader_v2_config.label: Sourced fact for the file; Community report that it is what was trained

lineage.trained_on: its README's 24 aligned and 5 native label sets
lineage.label: Sourced fact

lineage.description: Hybrid local-3D-stem / 2D U-Net on the aligned 21-slice corpus: 17-of-21 jittered Z window, fixed scroll-prior batch sampling, robust-MAD normalization, smoothed BCE + Dice. Fill in out_dir and the datasets block for your data layout; the full corpus contract (29 representations across 4 scrolls) is aligned21_fixed_scroll_prior.json.
lineage.label: Sourced fact for the file

lineage.description: Reader V3: Reader v2 continued on 256 px tiles (30k it), then on 384 px tiles (20k it, this config), batch 10, same data + labels.
lineage.label: Sourced fact for the file

reader-v2.note: domenicor046/reader-v2; the same 99 training keys as Reader V3 (its train_config.json). The selection rows are Reader V3's author suite and are listed for Reader V3 only

argus-v2.note: Reader V3 fine-tuned by ruiconte on native 8 to 9 um scans (ruiconte/argus-v2); its own fine-tune segments are not in this registry

reader-pu.note: Reader V3 retuned by Domenico Russo with ScribblePU positive-unlabelled training (domenicor046/scribble-pu); the segments of its retuning are not in this registry
